comparisons.peer_summary: The company provides read channel SoCs, preamplifiers, and custom flash controllers for HDD and SSD OEMs to manage data storage and access.
comparisons.comparison: Both Micron and Broadcom describe integrated storage solutions that combine memory/flash with controllers to handle data management tasks internally. Micron describes 'Managed NAND' which integrates NAND flash with a controller and firmware to handle wear leveling, bad block management, and error correction. Similarly, Broadcom describes 'custom flash controllers' for SSDs that manage underlying flash memory by performing error correction, wear leveling, and bad block management. While Micron packages these elements into a single 'Managed NAND' product (eMMC/UFS) often used in mobile and industrial markets, Broadcom focuses on providing the controller SoC to SSD OEMs for data storage and access.

sentences.text: Managed NAND: Managed NAND combines NAND flash with a sophisticated controller and firmware in a single package.
This integration allows the memory to manage itself, handling tasks like wear leveling, bad block management, and error correction internally, freeing the host system from these tasks.
We also provide custom flash controllers to SSD OEMs. An SSD stores data in flash memory instead of on a hard disk, providing high speed access to the data.

Flash controllers manage the underlying flash memory in SSDs, performing critical functions such as reading and writing data to and from the flash memory and performing error correction, wear leveling and bad block management.
